youtube.title: Socrates' last words were about a CHICKEN 🐓 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Socrates' famous last words: not about truth. About a chicken 🐓

What would YOUR famous last words be? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 399 BC Athens sentenced Socrates to death by hemlock. In Plato's Crito his friend Crito begs him to escape and he refuses. In Plato's Phaedo his last words are to Crito: "we owe a rooster to Asclepius; pay it and don't forget."
